tools.description: Search available empty leg flights by origin, destination, date range, passenger count, and an optional max_price ceiling. tools.name: get_flight

tools.name: booking_handoff
tools.description: Return the SkyAccess booking page link for a specific empty leg flight, for handing to a customer so they can review and book it themselves. This is READ-ONLY: it does not create, hold, modify or cancel any booking, and no booking exists until the customer completes it on the page. Use request_booki

tools.name: get_charter_estimate
tools.description: Returns an indicative price range (min/max USD) for a private charter flight between two locations. Optionally filter by aircraft category and passenger count. When no category is specified, returns estimates for all aircraft suitable for the route and group size.

tools.name: request_booking
tools.description: Submit a charter flight booking request. A SkyAccess specialist will contact the requester within 2 hours to confirm availability and pricing. No payment is required at this stage — this initiates the enquiry.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_flight, booking_handoff · Private data: search_empty_legs, booking_handoff, get_charter_estimate, request_booking · Public sink: request_booking · Destructive: booking_handoff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_flight, booking_handoff · Private data: search_empty_legs, booking_handoff, get_charter_estimate, request_booking · Public sink: request_booking · Destructive: booking_handoff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
